notes: A classifies the required assembly strategy; D owns release/press poses and execution. No measured grasp, tool envelope or robot waypoint is required for this classification.

assumption_notes: 1 stud side gap permits gripper entry/release in the local rule; D determines the actual small-opening command.
HOLD checks two local side spaces one pitch wide and one body high. U gripper intrusion into L grip space is assumed absent.
PRESS uses a one-pitch patch and local side entry; full finger/arm reach and exact tool body are not verified.
Internal assembly_board_mm has Z=0 at board body support face, XY at first stud centre. SI/D frame mapping remains draft.
Finger lower boundary at 5mm equals nominal stud top. Box model allows tangency without positive measured clearance; full collision/mesh validation remains required.
